riskAnalysis: R04 closed the shared open-finding validation defect but found that reviewedStateCommit was only checked for existence and ancestry, allowing a ledger to cite a commit without the claimed frozen REVIEW submission. R05 loads planning/backlog.yaml from every immutable reviewed-state commit; requires the exact hold, bootstrap, REVIEW status, current submission attempt/candidate/evidence/criteria hash, branch, implementation commit, evidence and null-review projection; requires strict candidate ancestry; and compares the exact ordered prior-attempt history. The executable fixture now commits a genuine REVIEW state before approval when its source is CHANGES_REQUESTED or BLOCKED. A new adversarial case substitutes a later ancestral commit whose backlog lacks the claimed REVIEW submission and proves byte-stable denial. Immutable Git-blob caching limits the cost of repeated historical checks without weakening commit binding. The exact 109-test focused suite and all 118 governed-file quality checks pass at candidate 42e016bca44d9046e0e27599d679bc69d28d3384, with authority, backlog, recovery, review-site, generated-view, and diff checks also passing.
